Name: CEP IT Band Strap Sports Medicine
Natural: CEP IT Band Strap Sports Medicine : The CEP IT Band Strap delivers pain relief from Iliotibial Band Syndrome (ITBS), Lateral Knee Pain and inflamed areas of the IT Band. All you have to do is adjust the hook-and-loop strap to the perfect level of tightness. A unique Crosstrap system keeps it secure and in place during all of your athletic movement. Delivers a medium support level. One size fits most.
